passage.label: Allah does not forbid you from those who do not fight you because of religion and do not expel you from your homes from being righteous toward them and acting justly toward them, indeed Allah loves those who act justly; Allah only forbids you from those who fight you because of religion and expel you from your homes and aid in your expulsion that you make allies of them, whoever makes allies of them those are the wrongdoers

arabicExcerpts.text: لَّا يَنۡهَىٰكُمُ ٱللَّهُ عَنِ ٱلَّذِينَ لَمۡ يُقَٰتِلُوكُمۡ فِي ٱلدِّينِ وَلَمۡ يُخۡرِجُوكُم مِّن دِيَٰرِكُمۡ أَن تَبَرُّوهُمۡ وَتُقۡسِطُوٓاْ إِلَيۡهِمۡۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُحِبُّ ٱلۡمُقۡسِطِينَ

إِنَّمَا يَنۡهَىٰكُمُ ٱللَّهُ عَنِ ٱلَّذِينَ قَٰتَلُوكُمۡ فِي ٱلدِّينِ وَأَخۡرَجُوكُم مِّن دِيَٰرِكُمۡ وَظَٰهَرُواْ عَلَىٰٓ إِخۡرَاجِكُمۡ أَن تَوَلَّوۡهُمۡۚ وَمَن يَتَوَلَّهُمۡ فَأُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَ

mainSubject.label: The distinction drawn between two categories of non-believers: those who neither fight over religion nor expel the believers, toward whom righteousness and justice are permitted since Allah loves the just; and those who fight over religion, expel the believers and assist in their expulsion, alliance with whom is forbidden and renders the ally a wrongdoer

subordinateSubjects.label: Righteousness and justice permitted toward those who neither fight over religion nor expel the believers, since Allah loves the just
Alliance forbidden with those who fight over religion, expel the believers and assist in their expulsion, rendering the ally a wrongdoer

notes: Wave 9 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the kinship-futility and Resurrection-judgement statement (3) before the Abrahamic pattern opens (4); P2 ends with the possible-affection concession (7) before the two-category justice rule begins (8); P3 covers the permitted and forbidden categories of non-believers (8-9); P4 runs from the examination of emigrant women through compensation rulings, the women's pledge and the closing alliance prohibition (10-13).
